name: workbench-cosmograph-shim-build
description: One-shot local build tool that bundles @cosmograph/cosmograph into a vendored, pinned ESM shim at crates/workbench-web/js/cosmograph-shim.js (Phase 42, D-16/D-17/WBX-07). Not a Cargo concern, not part of the normal cargo build/test/clippy path. Re-run only as an explicit, reviewed upgrade step: `npm install && npx esbuild cosmograph-shim-src.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=../js/cosmograph-shim.js`.
